description: This file defines the AutoPurgeService class responsible for automatically purging old tasks to manage disk space, including methods for classifying tasks, determining eligibility for purging, deleting task files, and gathering storage statistics.

classes.name: AutoPurgeService
classes.description: Service responsible for managing automatic purging of old tasks based on retention policies and disk space management.

methods.name: purgeOldTasks
methods.description: Main method to purge old tasks based on provided settings, task history, and options.

methods.name: getTasksEligibleForPurge
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tasks that are eligible for purging based on retention policies.

methods.name: classifyTask
methods.description: Classifies a task as favorited, completed, or incomplete based on its properties and completion status.

methods.name: checkTaskCompletion
methods.description: Checks if a task has been completed by examining its UI messages.

methods.name: getRetentionDaysForTaskType
methods.description: Returns the retention period in days for a given task type based on settings.

methods.name: deleteTaskFiles
methods.description: Deletes all files associated with a specific task.

methods.name: getTaskSizeBytes
methods.description: Calculates the size of a task directory in bytes.

methods.name: isTaskActive
methods.description: Determines if a task is currently active.

methods.name: getTaskStorageStats
methods.description: Gathers statistics about task storage, including total size and counts by task type.
